newsitem.title: USA: Spanlink sees Q4 loss $0.14 to $0.17/shr.
newsitem.headline: Spanlink sees Q4 loss $0.14 to $0.17/shr.

text.p: Spanlink Communications Inc said Thursday it expects to report revenues for the fourth quarter ended December 31, 1996 of about $2 million and a net loss for the quarter between $0.14 and $0.17 a share.
For the year, the company said it expects total revenues of about $5.4 million, an increase of 25 percent from last year. The loss for the year is projected between $0.63 and $0.66 a share.
The projected fourth quarter sales would be a record for the company and an increase of 72 percent over last year, the company said.
Spanlink said projected revenues are slightly less than analysts' estimates of $2.4 million for the quarter and $5.8 million for the year.
The projected loss per share is greater than analysts' estimates of $0.12 for the quarter but the projected annual loss is less than the $0.70 estimate, the company said.

"The estimated shortfall in sales and earnings is due primarily to a delay in the closing of several large orders and a slower than planned ramp-up in direct and dealer sales," Spanlink said in a release.

Spanlink provides interactive computer telecommunications software and services linking business computer systems, telecommunications systems and the Internet. It launched an intial public offering in April 1996.
